discovery_method: batch L4 + ref triage (real fix 24c322fd; first-cited f186c50 is a same-day cleanup commit)

public_upstream.fix_subject: avfilter/vf_floodfill: size the point stack for the current frame (Fixes: out of array access; repro 8aj_floodfill_dynamic_size.pgm)

oh_source.l4_evidence: config_input allocates s->points = av_calloc(inlink->w * inlink->h, 4 * sizeof(Points)) once; filter_frame pushes points with frame->width/height bounds — OOB write when frame exceeds config size. Upstream diff applies clean

vulnerability.summary: Flood-fill point stack is allocated for the configured link size (with 4x slack) but driven by the current frame's dimensions; a sufficiently larger frame overruns the stack.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed; family equivalence to runtime-verified CVE-2026-66036/66041. Runtime attempt documented honestly: poc_floodfill.c built (GRAY8 direct graph), 512^2/8192^2/12288^2/1x1->64^2 parameter sets did not trigger ASan — the 4x allocation slack keeps the LIFO flood-fill stack depth below capacity for uniform frames, and >256MB frame allocations fail; a non-uniform pattern (checkerboard/spiral) to maximize DFS depth is left as follow-up

notes: size-family member 4 of 4; runtime evidence for the family carried by hqdn3d/quirc

attack_path:
前提条件：产品/应用使用 ffmpeg 滤镜图包含 floodfill（区域填充
场景）且处理尺寸动态变化的输入流。攻击者构造分辨率远大于初始
配置的帧序列驱动点栈越界；是否需要用户交互取决于应用是否自动
处理不可信输入。越界写内容为坐标数据，可致堆内存破坏。

四、PoC & Exploit：

组合与原因分析如实呈现）；证据主体为三侧源码对照与同族运行级
类比，附件 patch.diff 为可直接应用的修复。
